title: The Countdown Clock: What August 11 Reveals About the Knicks' Championship Future
description:
As the New York Knicks celebrate their 2026 championship, a hidden deadline on August 11 reveals the real challenge: keeping it together. Karl-Anthony Towns is eligible for a $272 million extension, but reports say the Knicks won't offer the max. Miles McBride deserves a raise, but the second apron might price him out. Both players are expected to wait until after the deadline to sign, ensuring they can't be traded mid-season. What does that tell us about trust, loyalty, and the business of defending a title? This deep dive explores the August 11 deadline, the Brunson precedent, James Dolan's cap mandate, and the historical parallels that explain why winning once is hard—but winning twice is harder.
